name: Anderson Collection at Stanford University
notes: Ennead's building (2014) on Stanford's arts district: three horizontal bars - a glazed ground floor set back under a cantilevered tan gallery box, subtly bow-tie in plan, with window bands recessed into each side and framed in zinc, topped by a smaller bar of clerestory glass under a zinc cap; campus oaks round it. Footprint and orientation from the ground file (about 60 x 36 m, long east-west); the massing from Architectural Record, Architizer and The Architect's Newspaper. Guessed: heights (about 17 m overall), the band positions, the entrance on the south. No photographs were available.
